listing.name: Haunting Ground — hauntingground-recomp (LasVola)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the start and early castle gameplay. Saving, Hewie, later chapters and endings remain untested. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS21075 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s local generation, module and build instructions. This LasVola project is separate from KunoDemetries’ HG and HG2 codebases.
